title: atractylis rubra
intro: Atractylis rubra, commonly known as Red Thistle, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Red Thistle include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic, making it useful for treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Atractylis rubra include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
